statement: The browser presents Pi history as a read-only, private conversation projection: only completed user/assistant message events become messages; plain text and image placeholders are rendered, while non-message/tool events are omitted except an assistant tool-name summary when no text exists. Remote terminal control remains separate from this history pane.
consequence: Rendering arbitrary event payloads or suggesting the browser can continue an agent turn would misrepresent the durable transcript and its control boundary.

enforcedAt.trigger: The browser maps persisted/live Pi events to visible conversation history
